interface: CLI: CURRENT_SNAP=<fixture pointer> python3 text_check.py FILE -> first line stamp, then '<STATUS> <file> (...)' with STATUS in PASS|BLOCK|TEXT UNVERIFIED|SKIP, then '    BLOCK ...' / '    WARN ...' lines; exit 0 clear, 1 BLOCK or TEXT UNVERIFIED, 2 bad input (council-tools/text-check/README.md).
fixture: run_kit builds a fresh fake v608build/snap-t + pointer + small PASTE (the same layout as Auditor's harnesses audit/text-check-g1/harness-tc.py and g3/harness-caption.py) per run, then writes each case's files with fixed mtimes.
expect_values: BLOCK = status BLOCK; UNVERIFIED = status TEXT UNVERIFIED; NOT-BLOCK = exit 0 (PASS or SKIP); WARN:<token> = exit 0 and a WARN line containing <token>
